title: Signals
versionOrDate: OpenTelemetry signal-status documentation reviewed 2026-08-02; events and profiles were still described as developing or proposal-stage signals
relevance: Official OpenTelemetry taxonomy for traces, metrics, logs, baggage, events and profiles. It supports the lesson's five-evidence-signal map while preserving a dated maturity boundary: support and stability vary by signal, language, component and backend, so the taxonomy is not proof that a particular deployment collects every signal.
